desc: Ideate the mathematical transformation ($N = X^2$ where $X$ has exactly 2 distinct prime factors) and algorithmic approach (Sieve + Binary Search).
Implement the sieve to count distinct prime factors up to $10^6$.
Generate the sorted list of valid roots (numbers with exactly 2 distinct prime factors).
Process each query using binary search on the precomputed list and print results.
Ensure the solution handles constraints efficiently and is enclosed in the required delimiters.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
